issues.legal_issue: An acquisition does not lapse under Section 24(2) of the 2013 Act where possession of the acquired land has been taken, even if compensation has not been paid.
Taking possession under the 1894 Act is established by the prescribed possession proceedings, and land vests in the State with possession after the award and taking of possession.

A subsequent change in the governing interpretation of Section 24(2) applies when deciding whether an acquisition has lapsed, even if the lower court decided the case under the earlier interpretation.
